statement: Compute the exact per-stratum survivor exceptional-block census after the audited N220 cut, so downstream Picard leaf work can be prioritized by actual surviving outer-block count rather than raw terminal count.

scope.quantifiers: exact census over every authorized post-node-mass (row_id,d,e) stratum
scope.required_output: deterministic per-stratum stream hash, exact aggregate totals, small-block buckets, and minimum-block strata

next_action: RUN_LIGHTWEIGHT_N250_REPLAY; IF PASS, USE THE CENSUS TO PRIORITIZE LOW-BLOCK STRATA FOR ANY FUTURE SOURCE-LOCKED LEAF CONTRACT WITHOUT DUPLICATING EX5 SOLVER RESEARCH
notes: N250 does not change the N220 survivor set and does not grant a new exclusion.
An exceptional block is the outer N230 exceptional-prefix coordinate; x4 remains the independent innermost normal block.
The census is intended to expose strata where an EX5-style block certificate could close a large canonical terminal range with very few outer signatures.
No heavy compute, theorem/receiver/endpoint, existence/nonexistence, or merge credit is authorized.
